summary: Console usage heatmap bucketization produces missing hourly spikes when zooming/adjusting timescale
description: Issue summary: Customers (BetaForms) report that the Console usage heatmap shows clear hourly spikes in a broad 7-day view, but when zooming into the hourly range the spikes disappear or are redistributed across non-intuitive buckets. Impact: Customers cannot reconcile observed token usage against billing exports for specific hours. This causes billing confusion for enterprise customers and blocks audits. Environment: Production console, us-east region. Observed since ~2026-03-09 22:00 UTC after a console release. Frequency: Intermittent on some orgs; reproducible for BetaForms datasets. Observed vs Expected: Observed: spikes visible at 1d aggregation but vanish when switching to 1h-aggregations. Expected: spike amplitude should be preserved across aggregation scales (just redistributed to smaller buckets).
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Login to Console as an org admin (BetaForms-like dataset). 2) Open Usage -> Heatmap -> select last 7 days (bucket size auto). 3) Note a pronounced spike on Day 3 around 14:00 UTC. 4) Zoom to Day 3 and change timescale to hourly or click into the heatmap to view that day. 5) Observe spike disappears or is split across several non-adjacent hour buckets.
logs: Support attached two CSV exports from BetaForms (export ids: exp-20260310-01, exp-20260310-02) and frontend console trace id console:trace:2026-03-10:7f2b. Backend query ids: analytics-query-13244, rollup-job-2109. Relevant console logs show aggregation window set to 'auto' and client side re-bucketizer applying a 5-minute snap that differs from server rollups. Example server rollup entry: {timestamp: "2026-03-03T14:00:00Z", tokens: 1_200_000}. Frontend trace shows derived buckets: 14:00-14:05: 200k; 14:05-15:00: 50k (inconsistent).
comments: Aisha Kumar (Support) 2026-03-10: Customer reports mismatch; attached CSVs and screenshot. Marking P1 due to enterprise billing impact.

Diego Morales (On-call Eng) 2026-03-10: Acknowledged. Assigning to analytics-team. Initial hunch: client-side bucketization introduced in recent console UI PR to 'align' heatmap grid may be diverging from server rollups.

Priya Desai (Analytics) 2026-03-11: Ran server query analytics-query-13244. Server hourly rollups look correct and monotonically sum to raw exports. Discrepancy appears to be in frontend aggregation when switching scales. Saved a repro session and uploaded to S3: s3://redwood-support/repro/sup-74512/session-20260311.json

Diego Morales (Eng) 2026-03-11: Reproduced locally. The frontend uses a 'smartSnap' algorithm that collapses small adjacent buckets into the nearest grid line; for sparse large spikes this reduces reported amplitude. PR opened to revert that change pending CI: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console-ui/pull/3387

BetaForms (Customer) 2026-03-11: Thanks — we can use the raw export as a workaround but would prefer heatmap to match exports. Please advise ETA for fix and whether backfill will be needed for our audit window.

Diego Morales (Eng) 2026-03-12: Rolling out frontend patch to disable smartSnap for heatmaps. Also scheduling a backend backfill to recompute any hourly rollups created during the affected window (2026-03-09 20:00 UTC through 2026-03-10 04:00 UTC). Will report when rollout completes.
investigation_notes: Hypotheses: (1) Frontend smartSnap aggregator introduced in console-ui@v2.14 causes non-lossless re-bucketing when moving between aggregation scales. (2) Inconsistent timezone/align-to-hour logic between rollup service and frontend could further misplace partial buckets. Actions taken: reproduced locally with BetaForms export; compared server hourly rollups to raw exports (sum matched), while frontend derived buckets did not. Reviewed PR history and identified PR 3387 touched heatmap binning logic. Verified server rollup job config (rollup-job-2109) unchanged. Intermediate mitigation: disable smartSnap UI option via feature flag and re-run UI tests. Backfill plan: queued rollup recompute job for the small affected window and added backfill ticket to scheduler (INT-9127).
resolution: Fix deployed: Frontend patch (console-ui PR #3387 reverted specific smartSnap path) merged and rolled to prod on 2026-03-12 at 03:20 UTC. Feature-flag removed for affected orgs. Backfill: analytics team executed backfill job to recompute hourly rollups for 2026-03-09 20:00 UTC -> 2026-03-10 04:00 UTC; results matched raw exports. Customer notified and provided corrected CSVs and a short audit summary. Workarounds provided prior to fix: (a) use raw usage exports (Admin -> Usage -> Export) which matched billing; (b) switch heatmap to 'show raw buckets' toggle (temporary flag). Follow-up actions: add an automated integration test to assert that frontend heatmap binning is lossless relative to server rollup sums (ticket INT-9344), add a canary check on control plane deploys to detect smartSnap regressions, and update the Heatmap Runbook with troubleshooting steps. Status: Resolved for BetaForms; monitoring for other orgs continues for 72h.
